text: 次のアプデでこの武器ネフられるって噂だよ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 開幕で全員バフってから一気に突っ込もう。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ボスにデバフる前に自分が倒されてて笑った。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 今日は誰もオンラインいないし、ソロるわ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 昨日友達とデュオってたら気づいたら朝だった。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 削ったのは俺なのにラスヒだけ持ってかれた〜

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: たまに野良ってみると知らない人と仲良くなれる。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 給料日だし、限定キャラ出るまでガチャるか。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 今日エイムがガバいのは寝不足のせいってことで。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: あの屋根の上が強ポジだから先に取っとけ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 相手ずっとガン待ちしてて全然攻めてこないんだけど？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 起き上がりに必殺技ぶっぱする人、多すぎない？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 復活した瞬間リスキルされるの理不尽すぎる。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 弱った敵をハイエナるのがこのモードの基本だよ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 最後は一人でキャリってくれてマジで助かった。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 回線落ちしたせいでポイント減ったんだが。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 味方がわざとトロってて試合にならない。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ボス戦をノーダメで抜けたらスクショ貼るね。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ランク沼にハマって三日間同じ帯から抜け出せない。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: このステージ、初見殺しの罠が多すぎるだろ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 相手に煽りプされて逆に燃えてきた。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: フルパだとボイチャで指示出せるから楽。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 初めて赤スパ投げたら名前読んでもらえて叫んだ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ゆる勢なので週末しかログインしません。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 序盤のボスなのにこれ鬼ムズじゃない？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 昨日三時まで起きてたから眠みがすごい。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 財布を家に忘れてきた、やばみ。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 誕生日に手紙もらって、うれしみが止まらない。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 卒業アルバム見返してたらエモみがすごかった。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 月曜の朝の満員電車、しんどみ強くない？

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 店員さんへの態度見て一瞬で蛙化した。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 今週バイト詰めすぎて、もうキャパい。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 昨日の寝落ち通話、途中から記憶ない。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: レポートの締め切り明日なのに白紙でヤバたにえん。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 落とし物届けてくれるとか、あの人ぐう聖じゃん。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 姉のとこの子の寝顔、ぐうかわすぎて無理。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 帰りにドンキってから合流するね。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 新しい服着て、ずっと鏡の前で自撮ってた。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 小テストの点数見てさげぽよなんだけど。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ライブのチケット当たってあげぽよ！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: また約束すっぽかすとか、マジで激おこだから！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: この程度でへばるなんて、とんだクソザコだな。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 威勢のわりに意外と雑魚いじゃん、お前。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 先輩が私の名前を呼んだ……尊死する……。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 三日も寝てないとか、完全にゲー廃じゃん！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: その笑顔は反則です、鬼かわすぎる！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 雨で遠足中止とか萎えぽよ〜。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: あんたのその言い方、ウザみしかないんだけど！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: ガチャ禁三日目……指が勝手に動きそうだ……。

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15

text: 王子がそんなこと言うわけない、解釈違いです！

source.attribution: monosashi synthetic sentence, written by Claude (Anthropic), 2026-10-15
